scripts.dev: concurrently -n core,store -c blue,magenta "bun --cwd core dev" "bun --cwd store dev"
scripts.lint: bun --cwd core lint && bun --cwd core lint:types && bun --cwd store lint
scripts.test: bun run test:bun && bun run test:vitest
scripts.test:full: bun run test:bun && bun run test:vitest
scripts.test:bun: bun test tests/unit tests/integration/routes tests/integration/runtime tests/integration/server tests/integration/store tests/integration/plugins tests/perf tests/security
scripts.test:assistant:live: bun run test:assistant:live:openai && bun run test:assistant:live:openrouter && bun run test:assistant:live:cms:openai && bun run test:assistant:live:cms:openrouter
scripts.test:assistant:live:cms: set -a && source .env && set +a && bun test tests/integration/assistant-live
scripts.test:assistant:live:cms:openai: set -a && source .env && set +a && TEST_OPENROUTER_API_KEY= TEST_OPENROUTER_MODEL= bun test tests/integration/assistant-live
scripts.test:assistant:live:cms:openrouter: set -a && source .env && set +a && TEST_OPENAI_API_KEY= TEST_OPENAI_MODEL= bun test tests/integration/assistant-live
scripts.test:coverage:all: bun run test:coverage && bun run test:coverage:bun
scripts.test:unit: bun run test:unit:bun && bun run test:unit:vitest
scripts.test:integration: bun test tests/integration/routes tests/integration/runtime tests/integration/server tests/integration/store tests/integration/plugins
scripts.scan:security: bun run scan:semgrep && bun run scan:trivy && bun run scan:gitleaks
scripts.scan:security:strict: bun run scan:semgrep:strict && bun run scan:trivy:strict && bun run scan:gitleaks:strict
scripts.scan:trivy: trivy fs --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --ignore-unfixed --skip-dirs _docs --skip-dirs node_modules --skip-dirs dist --skip-dirs build --skip-dirs .next .
scripts.scan:trivy:strict: trivy fs --exit-code 1 --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --ignore-unfixed --skip-dirs _docs --skip-dirs node_modules --skip-dirs dist --skip-dirs build --skip-dirs .next .
scripts.db:generate: set -a; [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; set +a; bunx drizzle-kit generate --config core/db/drizzle.config.ts
scripts.db:migrate: set -a; [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; set +a; bunx drizzle-kit migrate --config core/db/drizzle.config.ts
